1.web: Every wise woman builds her house, but the foolish one tears it down with her own hands.
1.asv: Every wise woman buildeth her house; But the foolish plucketh it down with her own hands.

2.web: He who walks in his uprightness fears Yahweh, but he who is perverse in his ways despises him.
2.asv: He that walketh in his uprightness feareth Jehovah; But he that is perverse in his ways despiseth him.

3.web: The fool’s talk brings a rod to his back, but the lips of the wise protect them.
3.asv: In the mouth of the foolish is a rod forhispride; But the lips of the wise shall preserve them.

4.web: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean, but much increase is by the strength of the ox.
4.asv: Where no oxen are, the crib is clean; But much increase is by the strength of the ox.

5.web: A truthful witness will not lie, but a false witness pours out lies.
5.asv: A faithful witness will not lie; But a false witness uttereth lies.

6.web: A scoffer seeks wisdom, and doesn’t find it, but knowledge comes easily to a discerning person.
6.asv: A scoffer seeketh wisdom, and findeth it not; But knowledge is easy unto him that hath understanding.

7.web: Stay away from a foolish man, for you won’t find knowledge on his lips.
7.asv: Go into the presence of a foolish man, And thou shalt not perceive in him the lips of knowledge.

8.web: The wisdom of the prudent is to think about his way, but the folly of fools is deceit.
8.asv: The wisdom of the prudent is to understand his way; But the folly of fools is deceit.

9.web: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
9.asv: A trespass-offering mocketh fools; But among the upright there is good will.

10.web: The heart knows its own bitterness and joy; he will not share these with a stranger.
10.asv: The heart knoweth its own bitterness; And a stranger doth not intermeddle with its joy.

11.web: The house of the wicked will be overthrown, but the tent of the upright will flourish.
11.asv: The house of the wicked shall be overthrown; But the tent of the upright shall flourish.

12.web: There is a way which seems right to a man, but in the end it leads to death.
12.asv: There is a way which seemeth right unto a man; But the end thereof are the ways of death.

13.web: Even in laughter the heart may be sorrowful, and mirth may end in heaviness.
13.asv: Even in laughter the heart is sorrowful; And the end of mirth is heaviness.

14.web: The unfaithful will be repaid for his own ways; likewise a good man will be rewarded for his ways.
14.asv: The backslider in heart shall be filled with his own ways; And a good manshall be satisfiedfrom himself.

15.web: A simple man believes everything, but the prudent man carefully considers his ways.
15.asv: The simple believeth every word; But the prudent man looketh well to his going.

16.web: A wise man fears, and shuns evil, but the fool is hot headed and reckless.
16.asv: A wise man feareth, and departeth from evil; But the fool beareth himself insolently, and is confident.

17.web: He who is quick to become angry will commit folly, and a crafty man is hated.
17.asv: He that is soon angry will deal foolishly; And a man of wicked devices is hated.

18.web: The simple inherit folly, but the prudent are crowned with knowledge.
18.asv: The simple inherit folly; But the prudent are crowned with knowledge.

19.web: The evil bow down before the good, and the wicked at the gates of the righteous.
19.asv: The evil bow down before the good; And the wicked, at the gates of the righteous.

20.web: The poor person is shunned even by his own neighbor, but the rich person has many friends.
20.asv: The poor is hated even of his own neighbor; But the rich hath many friends.

21.web: He who despises his neighbor sins, but blessed is he who has pity on the poor.
21.asv: He that despiseth his neighbor sinneth; But he that hath pity on the poor, happy is he.

22.web: Don’t they go astray who plot evil? But love and faithfulness belong to those who plan good.
22.asv: Do they not err that devise evil? But mercy and truth shall be to them that devise good.

23.web: In all hard work there is profit, but the talk of the lips leads only to poverty.
23.asv: In all labor there is profit; But the talk of the lipstendethonly to penury.

24.web: The crown of the wise is their riches, but the folly of fools crowns them with folly.
24.asv: The crown of the wise is their riches; But the folly of fools is only folly.

25.web: A truthful witness saves souls, but a false witness is deceitful.
25.asv: A true witness delivereth souls; But he that uttereth lies causeth deceit.

26.web: In the fear of Yahweh is a secure fortress, and he will be a refuge for his children.
26.asv: In the fear of Jehovah is strong confidence; And his children shall have a place of refuge.

27.web: The fear of Yahweh is a fountain of life, turning people from the snares of death.
27.asv: The fear of Jehovah is a fountain of life, That one may depart from the snares of death.

28.web: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory, but in the lack of people is the destruction of the prince.
28.asv: In the multitude of people is the king’s glory; But in the want of people is the destruction of the prince.

29.web: He who is slow to anger has great understanding, but he who has a quick temper displays folly.
29.asv: He that is slow to anger is of great understanding; But he that is hasty of spirit exalteth folly.

30.web: The life of the body is a heart at peace, but envy rots the bones.
30.asv: A tranquil heart is the life of the flesh; But envy is the rottenness of the bones.

31.web: He who oppresses the poor shows contempt for his Maker, but he who is kind to the needy honors him.
31.asv: He that oppresseth the poor reproacheth his Maker; But he that hath mercy on the needy honoreth him.

32.web: The wicked is brought down in his calamity, but in death, the righteous has a refuge.
32.asv: The wicked is thrust down in his evil-doing; But the righteous hath a refuge in his death.

33.web: Wisdom rests in the heart of one who has understanding, and is even made known in the inward part of fools.
33.asv: Wisdom resteth in the heart of him that hath understanding; Butthat which isin the inward part of fools is made known.

34.web: Righteousness exalts a nation, but sin is a disgrace to any people.
34.asv: Righteousness exalteth a nation; But sin is a reproach to any people.

35.web: The king’s favor is toward a servant who deals wisely, but his wrath is toward one who causes shame.
35.asv: The king’s favor is toward a servant that dealeth wisely; But his wrath will beagainsthim that causeth shame.
